mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon_usage_record ( id, user_coupon_id, coupon_template_id, user_id, order_no, action, order_amount_yuan, discount_amount_yuan, idempotency_key ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userCouponId}, #{couponTemplateId}, #{userId}, #{orderNo}, #{action}, #{orderAmountYuan}, #{discountAmountYuan}, #{idempotencyKey} ) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO coupon_usage_record ( id, user_coupon_id, coupon_template_id, user_id, order_no, action, order_amount_yuan, discount_amount_yuan, idempotency_key ) SELECT decode(raw.id_hex, 'hex'), decode(raw.user_coupon_id_hex, 'hex'), decode(raw.coupon_template_id_hex, 'hex'), raw.user_id, raw.order_no, raw.action, raw.order_amount_yuan, raw.discount_amount_yuan, raw.idempotency_key FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{recordsJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw( id_hex text, user_coupon_id_hex text, coupon_template_id_hex text, user_id bigint, order_no text, action text, order_amount_yuan numeric, discount_amount_yuan numeric, idempotency_key text ) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
